title: Тайник на складе  (Hiding Place in the Storeroom)

segments.t: In the quiet vegetable storeroom of Claude Monet, Max and Sasha scramble to hide Dmitry Nagiyev's unconscious dog among sacks of potatoes. Desperate to conceal the animal until nightfall, they use fragrant cilantro before art director Victoria walks in unexpectedly. Let's listen to their nervous conversation in Russian.
Пусть она полежит здесь до вечера.
Макс, почему ты не на кухне?
Быстро уходите, это вам не мотель.
Let's explore how Max and Sasha attempt to conceal their secret in the restaurant storeroom.
Пусть она полежит здесь до вечера.
'Let her lie here until evening.' The introductory hortative word expresses third-person permission and resignation for the characters.
'It will easily cover any odor.' Notice how naturally this everyday Russian phrase expresses the speaker's point.
'Tablecloths in the vegetable storeroom?' Victoria expresses skeptical disbelief through an everyday question the matching word ending.
Быстро уходите, это вам не мотель.

'Leave quickly, this is no motel for you.' A firm command form followed by a humorous colloquial dismissal. Now, let's listen to the storeroom conversation once more. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Now you know how to talk about hiding items, giving excuses, and handling unexpected workplace interruptions in Russian. Listen for these practical expressions in the upcoming scenes. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'fast' and 'evening' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
